info.name: Import keys and values from files into the Software Localization Project

params.name: target-languages
params.description:
Comma separated list of target languages
(optional, all target languages of the project by default, can only be specified when importing the source).
- Empty list of languages produces a 400 bad request error with an appropriate reason text
- An incorrect language code produces a 400 bad request error with an appropriate reason text
- If any language didn't exist in the project, it will be created (but not added as a target to any existing collections)
- If any language didn't exist in the collection (the target collection existed before), it will be added as a target to the collection

params.name: format
params.description:
Specifies the file format used to import the file (optional).
Smartcat will try to identify the file format from its extension.

params.name: completion-state
params.description:
Imported translation confirmation mode
draft — translation must be imported but not confirmed on any stage (default)
intermediate — the translation must be imported and automatically confirmed at the first project stage
final — the translation must be imported and confirmed on all project stages

params.name: labels
params.description: Comma-separated labels that will be attached to the created/updated segments (even if the text is not changed)

params.name: skip-conflicting-values
params.description:
Specifies how to deal with situations when the same key has a different
value in the imported file and in Smartcat - keeps the value in Smartcat by default

params.name: overwrite-conflicting-values
params.description: When the same key has a different value in the imported file and in Smartcat - use the value from the file

params.name: auto-file-labels
params.description: Should Smartcat automatically create labels after file names?

params.name: delete-missing-keys
params.description: Delete keys that are not present in the imported files

items.docs: Import keys and values from files into the Software Localization Project

info.name: Run export from Software Localization Project

params.name: collections
params.description: Comma-separated collections list to export (optional, "main" as default)

params.name: languages
params.description: Comma-separated list of languages to export (optional, all target languages by default)

params.name: path-separator
params.description:
Path separator string (optional)
When exporting "structured-json" and "structured-yaml" file formats,
this separator string will be used to split the key into multiple parts and construct the tree structure.

params.name: completion-state
params.description:
Minimal key completion state (optional)
Specifies the state in which any key (segment) must be in order to be exported.
draft — download any translations, even unconfirmed ones (default)
intermediate — download segments at the last confirmed stage
final — download segments that passed through all translation stages

params.name: fallback-to-default-language
params.description: Return default language values instead of incomplete translations (default)

params.name: export-incomplete-as-blank
params.description: Export blank values when no translation is ready

params.name: skip-incomplete-keys
params.description: Do not export keys that have no translations (will be used as a default for the "android-xml" export file type)

params.name: output-file-path-template
params.description:
Output file path template (Optional)
Specifies how the output files should be named and located.
You can use the {LANGUAGE} and {LABEL:PREFIX} placeholders to customize the output.
The {LOCALE:IOS} and {LOCALE:ANDROID} placeholders are also available for platform specific exports.
The ability to specify {LABEL:PREFIX} placeholder allows you to export keys that have the PREFIX value
of label prefix and use the label suffix to determine the file name.
See examples [here](http://developers.sc.local/software-localization/#file-path-template)

params.name: include-default-language
params.description: Specify if the default language should be included in the export

params.name: zip
params.description: Force export to a ZIP archive, even for a single file

params.name: modified-since
params.description: Export keys that were changed after the datetime

params.name: labels
params.description: Comma-separated list of labels to export keys that are marked with labels

params.name: indent
params.description: Indent for formatting the exporting file (optional, 2 spaces by default)
